content: Within six months, Sabrina will crawl independently for 5 feet on a carpeted surface in 4 out of 5 opportunities to enhance gross motor coordination and strength, promoting functional mobility.

Within six months, Sabrina will reach across midline to grasp a toy placed on the opposite side in 4 out of 5 opportunities with minimal assistance, enhancing bilateral coordination and spatial awareness during play.
Within three months, Sabrina will demonstrate sensory regulation by tolerating tactile input from a variety of textures during playtime without displaying avoidant behaviors in 4 out of 5 scenarios.
Within six months, Sabrina will independently transfer a toy from one hand to the other in 4 out of 5 opportunities to promote bilateral hand use and crossing midline.

Within six months, Sabrina will play alongside a peer, engaging in parallel play activities for at least 5 minutes, in 3 out of 5 play sessions to enhance social participation and early socialization skills.

Within three months, Sabrina will respond to simple requests or gestures during meal times with no more than 2 verbal prompts in 4 out of 5 opportunities, facilitating receptive language and mealtime routines.
Within three months, Sabrina will visually track a moving object across midline in 4 out of 5 opportunities, to develop visual-motor integration necessary for future learning tasks.
Within six months, Sabrina will demonstrate the ability to finger feed soft solids independently in 4 out of 5 meal opportunities to enhance self-care and adaptive skills.
